newsitem.title: USA: Mitsuzuka - markets must understand G7 intention.
newsitem.headline: Mitsuzuka - markets must understand G7 intention.

text.p: Japanese Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka said Monday that currency markets should clearly understand the intention of the statement by the Group of Seven industrial nations.
Mitsuzuka told reporters that the effect of the G7 statement is clear in calling for currency stability, which is needed for the stability of economies.
"The effects of the G7 statement will emerge sooner or later," he said.

The G7 issued a statement on Sunday stating that sharp volatility and deviation of exchange rates from economic fundamentals are undesirable, and that the group will cooperate as needed in currency markets.
